# UX & Modal Scroll Requirements Checklist: Modal Card Auto-Scroll & Non-Blocking Accordion Actions

**Purpose**: Validate requirements completeness, clarity, and consistency for modal card auto-scrolling, non-blocking accordion transitions, and action target accessibility.
**Created**: 2026-11-03
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are auto-scroll requirements explicitly specified when appending a new movement goal card via `+ Add Movement`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Are auto-scroll requirements specified when expanding an existing collapsed movement goal card in `CycleEditorDialog`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK003 Are auto-scroll requirements defined for appending a new block via `Add Block to Routine` in `RoutineEditorDialog`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]

## Requirement Clarity & Non-Blocking Accordion Rules

- [x] CHK004 Is the non-blocking accordion behavior unambiguously defined when a user taps a collapsed goal card while an unsaved empty draft (`id == 0 && !hasValidTarget`) is open? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK005 Is the restoration behavior specified when a previously valid goal's target is cleared to empty/zero and the user taps a different collapsed goal card? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK006 Is the validation and auto-scroll behavior defined when the user taps `Done ▲` or `+ Add Movement` while an open card has an invalid target (`<= 0`)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]

## Edge Case & Accessibility Coverage

- [x] CHK007 Are touch target separation (`Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)`) and independent action semantics specified for `Remove goal` and `Expand goal` on `CollapsedGoalSummaryCard`? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK008 Are viewport boundary cases (bottom-clipped, top-clipped, and card taller than viewport) addressed in the scroll offset model? [Edge Cases, Plan §Research-2, DataModel §2]
- [x] CHK009 Is the default empty-target initialization case (when the default first exercise has no historical best record) explicitly addressed in the edge cases? [Edge Cases, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK010 Are all success criteria measurable and aligned with the project's test and lint gates? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001..SC-004]
